Europe · late May to mid June 2027

London to Istanbul

Three weeks, five bases, 4–5 nights in each. Family and jet lag in London first, then Greek island beaches, boat days on the Turkish coast, and a city we haven't done to finish.

International flights are Taylor's Flight Centre quote. The hotels are real 4-star places on Booking.com. Their prices are typical early-summer rates found in September 2026, because most 2027 dates aren't priced yet. The links open each search with our dates, so the live price shows once rates load. Rates used: US$1 ≈ NZ$1.70. Paros and Fethiye fill up in June, so book on free cancellation early. Not included: car or quad hire, day boats, tours, food, insurance, and the UK ETA and ETIAS.

Going with Emirates premium economy. Qatar has no premium economy on this route. Premium on just the long legs (via Dubai) would save about $680 for the two of us.

Doing it ourselves

What to book, in order

  1. International flights through Taylor.
  2. Paros → Rhodes first. Check Blue Star's direct ferry days on Ferryhopper, or fly Sky Express / Aegean via Athens. Set the Paros and Rhodes dates around it.
  3. Rhodes → Fethiye fast ferry. Confirm the early-June timetable; weekends can sell out.
  4. London → Mykonos (easyJet or BA direct).
  5. Dalaman → Istanbul (Turkish, AJet or Pegasus). Cheap and frequent, so it can wait.
  6. Four places to stay, on free cancellation. Paros and Fethiye fill up in June.
Before we go

Admin

  • UK: ETA needed for NZ passports.
  • Greece (EU): ETIAS travel authorisation is likely to be in place by then.
  • Turkey: check the current entry rules for NZ passports.
  • Phones: an eSIM covering the EU and Turkey (Turkey isn't in EU roaming).
  • Money: euros in Greece; lira or card in Turkey.
  • Weather: sea about 20–22°C in late May, warmer every week into June.
